quote: the industry is seriously hampered by diseases which are the principal constraint of nurseries and grow-out mortalities in fish cultures (Loh et al., 2019).
statement: 疾病是水产养殖的主要制约因素，导致育苗和养成阶段的死亡率。
text_zh: 疾病是水产养殖的主要制约因素，导致育苗和养成阶段的死亡率。
text_en: Disease is a major limiting factor in aquaculture, causing mortality during the hatchery and grow-out stages.

quote: In order to prevent or control the infections, antibiotics have been widely used (Angela et al., 2020).
statement: 抗生素被广泛用于预防或控制感染。
text_zh: 抗生素被广泛用于预防或控制感染。
text_en: Antibiotics are widely used to prevent or control infections.

quote: All the selected fish was anaesthetized with an overdose of ethyl 3-aminobenzoate methanesulfonate (MS-222, 200 mg L–1).
statement: 所有选定的鱼均使用过量的乙基氨基苯甲酸甲磺酸酯（MS-222，200 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_zh: 所有选定的鱼均使用过量的乙基氨基苯甲酸甲磺酸酯（MS-222，200 mg/L）进行麻醉。
text_en: All selected fish were anesthetized using an overdose of ethyl aminobenzoate methanesulfonate (MS-222, 200 mg/L).
outcome: 采样过程中的应激控制

quote: Increasing evidence has revealed that composition disturbances in fish gut microbiota are critical risk factors in disease development (Nie et al., 2019).
statement: 越来越多的证据表明，鱼类肠道微生物群的组成紊乱是疾病发展的关键风险因素。
text_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，鱼类肠道微生物群的组成紊乱是疾病发展的关键风险因素。
text_en: Increasing evidence indicates that disruption of the composition of the fish gut microbiota is a key risk factor for disease development.

quote: the precarious conditions of water temperature change disturb the gut microbiota of fish, which is not a choice for sustainable development of aquaculture.
statement: 水温变化的不稳定条件会扰乱鱼类的肠道微生物群，这不利于水产养殖的可持续发展。
text_zh: 水温变化的不稳定条件会扰乱鱼类的肠道微生物群，这不利于水产养殖的可持续发展。
text_en: Unstable conditions of water temperature changes disrupt the gut microbiota of fish, which is detrimental to the sustainable development of aquaculture.

quote: several studies show that LAB and other probiotics can electively regulate the expression of proinflammatory and inflammatory cytokines including tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α, interleukin (IL)-6, IL-1β, and IL-10, interferon (IFN)-γ, etc. (Liu et al., 2016 ; Zhou et al., 2018 ; Xia et al., 2019 ; Jang et al., 2020).
statement: 多项研究表明，乳酸菌（LAB）和其他益生菌可以选择性地调节促炎和炎症细胞因子（包括TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IL-10、IFN-γ等）的表达。
text_zh: 多项研究表明，乳酸菌（LAB）和其他益生菌可以选择性地调节促炎和炎症细胞因子（包括TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IL-10、IFN-γ等）的表达。
text_en: Multiple studies have shown that lactic acid bacteria (LAB) and other probiotics can selectively modulate the expression of pro-inflammatory and inflammatory cytokines (including TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, IL-10, IFN-γ, etc.).

quote: immunomodulatory effects of LAB as feed additives have received increasing attention (Feng et al., 2016 , 2019 ; Giri et al., 2016).
statement: 作为饲料添加剂的乳酸菌（LAB）的免疫调节作用受到了越来越多的关注。
text_zh: 作为饲料添加剂的乳酸菌（LAB）的免疫调节作用受到了越来越多的关注。
text_en: The immunomodulatory effects of lactic acid bacteria (LAB) as feed additives have received increasing attention.

quote: Temperature changes have a great impact on fish feeding, intestinal microorganisms, metabolism, and immune function.
statement: 温度变化对鱼类的摄食、肠道微生物、代谢和免疫功能有重大影响。
text_zh: 温度变化对鱼类的摄食、肠道微生物、代谢和免疫功能有重大影响。
text_en: Temperature changes have a significant impact on the feeding, gut microbiota, metabolism, and immune function of fish.

quote: Therefore, it is necessary to develop effective methods to enhance the survival rates and growth of fish under water temperature changes.
statement: 因此，有必要开发有效方法以提高水温变化下鱼类的存活率和生长。
text_zh: 因此，有必要开发有效方法以提高水温变化下鱼类的存活率和生长。
text_en: Therefore, it is necessary to develop effective methods to improve fish survival and growth under water temperature changes.

quote: This study investigated the short-term effects of dietary LAB on intestinal microbiota composition and immune responses of crucian carp (Carassius auratus) when water temperature decreased from 30 ± 1°C to 18 ± 1°C.
statement: 本研究调查了当水温从30±1°C降至18±1°C时，日粮乳酸菌对鲫鱼肠道微生物组成和免疫反应的短期影响。
text_zh: 本研究调查了当水温从30±1°C降至18±1°C时，日粮乳酸菌对鲫鱼肠道微生物组成和免疫反应的短期影响。
text_en: This study investigated the short-term effects of dietary lactic acid bacteria on the intestinal microbiota composition and immune response of crucian carp when water temperature decreased from 30±1°C to 18±1°C.
outcome: 肠道微生物与免疫反应

quote: The results showed that the mortality rate of crucian carp in HC, HT, and HL group was 50, 27, and 33%, respectively.
statement: 结果显示，HC、HT和HL组鲫鱼的死亡率分别为50%、27%和33%。
text_zh: 结果显示，HC、HT和HL组鲫鱼的死亡率分别为50%、27%和33%。
text_en: The results showed that the mortality rates of crucian carp in the HC, HT, and HL groups were 50%, 27%, and 33%, respectively.

quote: The survival was monitored in all groups after being fed with A. hydrophila ATCC 7,966, L. lactis 1,209, and L. lactis 1,242, respectively.
statement: 在喂食嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7,966、乳酸乳球菌1,209和乳酸乳球菌1,242后，监测所有组的存活情况。
text_zh: 在喂食嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7,966、乳酸乳球菌1,209和乳酸乳球菌1,242后，监测所有组的存活情况。
intervention_record: 乳酸乳球菌饲喂及攻毒

quote: As shown in Table 2 , the mortality rate of HC (50%) was significantly higher than that of HT (27%) and HL (33%).
statement: 如表2所示，HC组（对照组）的死亡率（50%）显著高于HT组（27%）和HL组（33%）。
text_zh: 如表2所示，HC组（对照组）的死亡率（50%）显著高于HT组（27%）和HL组（33%）。
text_en: As shown in Table 2, the mortality rate of the HC group (control group) (50%) was significantly higher than that of the HT group (27%) and the HL group (33%).

quote: The results showed that the mortality of crucian carp in the LAB treatment group was lower than in the control group under the condition of temperature change.
statement: 结果表明，在温度变化条件下，乳酸菌（LAB）处理组鲫鱼的死亡率低于对照组。
text_zh: 结果表明，在温度变化条件下，乳酸菌（LAB）处理组鲫鱼的死亡率低于对照组。
text_en: The results showed that under temperature change conditions, the mortality rate of crucian carp in the lactic acid bacteria (LAB) treatment group was lower than that in the control group.

quote: Previous studies show that the proliferation of LAB in the intestine of fish suppresses the colonization of Gram-negative pathogenic bacteria (Kishawy et al., 2020).
statement: 先前的研究表明，鱼类肠道中乳酸菌的增殖可抑制革兰氏阴性致病菌的定植。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，鱼类肠道中乳酸菌的增殖可抑制革兰氏阴性致病菌的定植。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that the proliferation of lactic acid bacteria in the fish gut can inhibit the colonization of Gram-negative pathogenic bacteria.

quote: Moreover, aqua-feeds supplemented with LAB have been reported to stimulate the growth, enhance the disease resistance, effectively regulate the gut microbiota (Xia et al., 2020), and stimulate immune responses in cultured aquatic species (Ringo et al., 2018 ; Ashouri et al., 2020).
statement: 据报道，添加乳酸菌的水产饲料能刺激生长、增强抗病力、有效调节肠道菌群并刺激养殖水生动物的免疫反应。
text_zh: 据报道，添加乳酸菌的水产饲料能刺激生长、增强抗病力、有效调节肠道菌群并刺激养殖水生动物的免疫反应。
text_en: It is reported that aquaculture feed supplemented with lactic acid bacteria can stimulate growth, enhance disease resistance, effectively regulate gut microbiota, and stimulate the immune response of farmed aquatic animals.
outcome: 生长性能、抗病力、肠道菌群、免疫反应

quote: LAB is expected to be growth promoters and immunostimulants in aquaculture (LeBlanc et al., 2017).
statement: 乳酸菌在养殖业中被预期作为促生长剂和免疫刺激剂。
text_zh: 乳酸菌在养殖业中被预期作为促生长剂和免疫刺激剂。
text_en: Lactic acid bacteria are expected to be used as growth promoters and immunostimulants in aquaculture.

quote: Consequently, the application of LAB blends in fish feed has been proposed as an optimal strategy to explore their potential positive effects on gut microbiota and immune responses on fish (Busti et al., 2020).
statement: 因此，在鱼饲料中应用乳酸菌混合物已被提出作为一种探索其对鱼类肠道菌群和免疫反应潜在积极影响的最佳策略。
text_zh: 因此，在鱼饲料中应用乳酸菌混合物已被提出作为一种探索其对鱼类肠道菌群和免疫反应潜在积极影响的最佳策略。
text_en: Therefore, the application of a lactic acid bacteria mixture in fish feed has been proposed as an optimal strategy to explore its potential positive effects on the gut microbiota and immune response of fish.

quote: As is well known, environmental change can suppress fish immunity, leading fish to be infected by pathogens (Luo et al., 2021).
statement: 众所周知，环境变化会抑制鱼类免疫力，导致鱼类被病原体感染。
text_zh: 众所周知，环境变化会抑制鱼类免疫力，导致鱼类被病原体感染。
text_en: It is well known that environmental changes suppress fish immunity, leading to infection of fish by pathogens.

quote: As shown in Figure 4 , with the temperature suddenly decreasing, the concentration of HSP-70, TNF-α, and IL-6 in all groups were lower at 5 days than that of 0 day, especially in the HT and HL groups which were lower than of the HC group.
statement: 在温度突然下降的情况下，所有组别在第5天的HSP-70、TNF-α和IL-6浓度均低于第0天，其中HT组和HL组低于HC组。
text_zh: 在温度突然下降的情况下，所有组别在第5天的HSP-70、TNF-α和IL-6浓度均低于第0天，其中HT组和HL组低于HC组。
text_en: Under sudden temperature drop, the concentrations of HSP-70, TNF-α and IL-6 in all groups on day 5 were lower than those on day 0, with the HT group and HL group being lower than the HC group.

quote: the Simpson index showed otherwise, which signified that the diversity for the all groups decreased, and the HT and HL groups were higher than the HC group.
statement: Simpson指数显示所有组的多样性均下降，但HT和HL组仍高于HC组。
text_zh: Simpson指数显示所有组的多样性均下降，但HT和HL组仍高于HC组。
text_en: The Simpson index showed that diversity decreased in all groups, but the HT and HL groups remained higher than the HC group.
counterevidence: 所有组的多样性均下降

quote: all groups at 5 days were lower than that of the HC groups at 0 day, which signified the abundance for the LAB treatment groups was higher than the HC group under the sudden decrease of water temperature.
statement: 尽管第5天所有组的指标均低于第0天的HC组，但这表明在水温骤降条件下，LAB处理组的丰度高于HC组。
text_zh: 尽管第5天所有组的指标均低于第0天的HC组，但这表明在水温骤降条件下，LAB处理组的丰度高于HC组。
text_en: Although the indicators of all groups on day 5 were lower than those of the HC group on day 0, this indicates that under conditions of a sudden drop in water temperature, the abundance of the LAB treatment group was higher than that of the HC group.
counterevidence: 第5天所有组均低于第0天HC组

quote: The effects of LAB as feed additive on species composition were shown in Figures 1A–E .
statement: 图1A-E展示了作为饲料添加剂的乳酸菌（LAB）对物种组成的影响。
text_zh: 图1A-E展示了作为饲料添加剂的乳酸菌（LAB）对物种组成的影响。
text_en: Figure 1A-E shows the effect of lactic acid bacteria (LAB) as a feed additive on species composition.

quote: modifications of gastrointestinal microbiota by antibiotics can alter the likely benefit of the host–microbiota interaction or relationship (Yukgehnaish et al., 2020).
statement: 抗生素对胃肠道微生物群的改变可能会影响宿主与微生物群之间相互作用的潜在益处。
text_zh: 抗生素对胃肠道微生物群的改变可能会影响宿主与微生物群之间相互作用的潜在益处。
text_en: The alteration of the gastrointestinal microbiota by antibiotics may affect the potential benefits of host-microbiota interactions.

quote: several studies have demonstrated that the intake of probiotics can modify the composition of the intestinal microbiota and effectively assist in returning the microbiota, which were disturbed by antibiotics or other risk factors, to its normal beneficial composition (Gomez and Balcazar, 2008).
statement: 摄入益生菌可以改变肠道微生物群的组成，并有效协助恢复被抗生素或其他风险因素扰乱的微生物群至正常有益状态。
text_zh: 摄入益生菌可以改变肠道微生物群的组成，并有效协助恢复被抗生素或其他风险因素扰乱的微生物群至正常有益状态。
text_en: Probiotic intake can alter the composition of the gut microbiota and effectively assist in restoring the microbiota, which has been disrupted by antibiotics or other risk factors, to a normal beneficial state.

quote: In order to address infectious bacterial diseases in the long term, the addition of probiotics, as a more suitable technique approach, is accepted by many scientists due to its necessity and how it provides less harm to the ecosystem (Yukgehnaish et al., 2020).
statement: 为了长期解决传染性细菌疾病，添加益生菌作为一种更合适的技术手段，因其必要性和对生态系统危害较小而被许多科学家接受。
text_zh: 为了长期解决传染性细菌疾病，添加益生菌作为一种更合适的技术手段，因其必要性和对生态系统危害较小而被许多科学家接受。
text_en: To long-term solve infectious bacterial diseases, adding probiotics as a more appropriate technical means is accepted by many scientists due to its necessity and lower harm to the ecosystem.

quote: Probiotics can effectively improve the growth rates and feeding efficiency of fish and regulate their gut microbiota (Iribarren et al., 2012 ; Bachruddin et al., 2018 ; Volkoff, 2019).
statement: 益生菌能有效提高鱼类的生长率和摄食效率，并调节其肠道微生物群。
text_zh: 益生菌能有效提高鱼类的生长率和摄食效率，并调节其肠道微生物群。
text_en: Probiotics can effectively improve the growth rate and feed efficiency of fish, and regulate their gut microbiota.
outcome: 生长性能/摄食效率/肠道微生物群

quote: Recent studies show that probiotics and prebiotics not only promote the growth performance but also fortify the immune system in cultured aquatic species.
statement: 近期研究表明，益生菌和益生元不仅促进养殖水生动物的生长性能，还增强其免疫系统。
text_zh: 近期研究表明，益生菌和益生元不仅促进养殖水生动物的生长性能，还增强其免疫系统。
text_en: Recent studies have shown that probiotics and prebiotics not only promote the growth performance of farmed aquatic animals, but also enhance their immune systems.

quote: In addition, environmental fluctuations that induce physiological stress were demonstrated to affect the survival, growth, physiological, and immunological functions of aquatic animals (Pai-Po et al., 2017).
statement: 诱导生理应激的环境波动会影响水生动物的存活、生长、生理和免疫功能。
text_zh: 诱导生理应激的环境波动会影响水生动物的存活、生长、生理和免疫功能。
text_en: Environmental fluctuations that induce physiological stress affect the survival, growth, physiology and immune function of aquatic animals.
outcome: 存活、生长及生理免疫功能

quote: Emerging evidence have also shown that exposure to ambient stressors, such as temperature change, may trigger severe diseases (Qi et al., 2020).
statement: 暴露于温度变化等环境压力源可能引发严重疾病。
text_zh: 暴露于温度变化等环境压力源可能引发严重疾病。
text_en: Exposure to environmental stressors such as temperature changes may trigger severe disease.

quote: Previous research has shown that acute changes in water temperature can affect body temperature of fish, induce changes their reaction rate of biological processes, and reduce their physiological performance (Yu et al., 2018).
statement: 水温的急剧变化会影响鱼类的体温，改变生物过程的反应速率，并降低其生理性能。
text_zh: 水温的急剧变化会影响鱼类的体温，改变生物过程的反应速率，并降低其生理性能。
text_en: Rapid changes in water temperature affect the body temperature of fish, alter the reaction rates of biological processes, and reduce their physiological performance.

quote: Water temperature plays a crucial role in nutrient utilization, metabolism, and regulation of gut microbiota (Sánchez-Nuño et al., 2018a ; Pelusio et al., 2021).
statement: 水温在营养利用、代谢和肠道微生物群调节中起着关键作用。
text_zh: 水温在营养利用、代谢和肠道微生物群调节中起着关键作用。
text_en: Water temperature plays a key role in nutrient utilization, metabolism, and gut microbiota regulation.
outcome: 营养利用、代谢及肠道菌群

quote: the relative abundance of Aeromonas and Lactobacillus significantly increased in the HT and HL groups compared to those in the HC group at 5 days
statement: 在第5天，与对照组（HC）相比，高温组（HT）和高乳酸菌组（HL）中气单胞菌属和乳杆菌属的相对丰度显著增加。
text_zh: 在第5天，与对照组（HC）相比，高温组（HT）和高乳酸菌组（HL）中气单胞菌属和乳杆菌属的相对丰度显著增加。
text_en: On day 5, compared with the control group (HC), the relative abundance of Aeromonas and Lactobacillus significantly increased in the high-temperature group (HT) and the high-lactic acid bacteria group (HL).
intervention_record: 温度结合乳酸菌饲料处理

quote: Cetobacteria and Burkholderia significantly decreased in the HT and HL groups compared with the HC group
statement: 与对照组（HC）相比，高温组（HT）和高乳酸菌组（HL）中梭杆菌属和伯克霍尔德氏菌属的相对丰度显著降低。
text_zh: 与对照组（HC）相比，高温组（HT）和高乳酸菌组（HL）中梭杆菌属和伯克霍尔德氏菌属的相对丰度显著降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group (HC), the relative abundance of Fusobacterium and Burkholderia was significantly reduced in the high-temperature group (HT) and the high-lactobacillus group (HL).
intervention_record: 温度结合乳酸菌饲料处理

quote: The survival rate of fish fed with L. lactis 1,209 were significantly higher than that of HC1 group.
statement: 饲喂乳酸乳球菌1,209组的鱼存活率显著高于HC1组。
text_zh: 饲喂乳酸乳球菌1,209组的鱼存活率显著高于HC1组。

quote: At 12 days, the survival rate of the crucian carp in both A. hydrophila group and the HC1 group was 0%, which was lower than that of the HT (30%) and HL group (20%).
statement: 在攻击实验第12天，嗜水气单胞菌组和HC1组的鲫鱼存活率为0%，低于HT组（30%）和HL组（20%）。
text_zh: 在攻击实验第12天，嗜水气单胞菌组和HC1组的鲫鱼存活率为0%，低于HT组（30%）和HL组（20%）。
text_en: On day 12 of the challenge experiment, the survival rate of crucian carp in the Aeromonas hydrophila group and the HC1 group was 0%, which was lower than that of the HT group (30%) and the HL group (20%).

quote: This research might contribute to help better understand the advantages involved in stimulating immune response and regulating gut microbiome of dietary LAB with water temperature change for crucian carp, which will be beneficial for understanding the positive influence of dietary LAB on aquaculture.
statement: 该研究可能有助于理解在水温变化下，日粮中添加乳酸菌（LAB）对鲫鱼免疫反应和肠道微生物群的调节优势。
text_zh: 该研究可能有助于理解在水温变化下，日粮中添加乳酸菌（LAB）对鲫鱼免疫反应和肠道微生物群的调节优势。
text_en: This study may help understand the regulatory advantages of dietary lactic acid bacteria (LAB) on immune responses and gut microbiota in crucian carp under water temperature changes.
outcome: 免疫反应与肠道微生物群

quote: Two hundred and thirty trial healthy fish were placed in 700 L (120*120*80 cm 3) tanks at 30 ± 1°C for 1 week and fed with the basal diet.
statement: 230条试验健康鱼被放置在700升水箱中，在30±1°C条件下饲养一周并喂食基础日粮。
text_zh: 230条试验健康鱼被放置在700升水箱中，在30±1°C条件下饲养一周并喂食基础日粮。
text_en: 230 healthy test fish were placed in a 700-liter tank, kept for one week at 30±1°C and fed a basal diet.
outcome: 养殖环境与初始健康状况

quote: Then, 225 healthy crucian carps similar in length (18 ± 2 cm) and body weight (250 ± 10 g) were randomly distributed into three groups [the basal commercial diet, HC; a basal diet with 1 × 10 6 CFU/ml of Lactococcus lactis 1,209 (L. lactis 1,209), HT; a basal diet with 1 × 10 6 CFU/ml of Lactococcus lactis 1,242 (L. lactis 1,242), HL].
statement: 随后，225条体长和体重相似的健康鲫鱼被随机分为三组：基础商业饲料组、添加乳球菌1,209的基础日粮组和添加乳球菌1,242的基础日粮组。
text_zh: 随后，225条体长和体重相似的健康鲫鱼被随机分为三组：基础商业饲料组、添加乳球菌1,209的基础日粮组和添加乳球菌1,242的基础日粮组。

quote: Twenty-five fish were randomly placed in each tank (70*50*40 cm 3), and each experiment was conducted in triplicate.
statement: 每个水箱（70*50*40立方厘米）中随机放置25条鱼，每项实验重复三次。
text_zh: 每个水箱（70*50*40立方厘米）中随机放置25条鱼，每项实验重复三次。
text_en: 25 fish were randomly placed in each tank (70*50*40 cubic centimeters), and each experiment was repeated three times.

quote: L. lactis 1,209 and L. lactis 1,242, obtained from Zhengzhou University, China, were selected by their strong immunomodulatory activities and adhesion capacities (Cui et al., 2018).
statement: 乳酸乳球菌1,209和1,242因其强免疫调节活性和粘附能力而被选择。
text_zh: 乳酸乳球菌1,209和1,242因其强免疫调节活性和粘附能力而被选择。

quote: Additionally, the crucian carp in the HC1 group and the A. hydrophila group died relatively earlier than that of the HT and HL groups.
statement: 此外，HC1组和嗜水气单胞菌组的鲫鱼死亡时间相对早于HT组和HL组。
text_zh: 此外，HC1组和嗜水气单胞菌组的鲫鱼死亡时间相对早于HT组和HL组。
text_en: In addition, the death time of crucian carp in the HC1 group and the Aeromonas hydrophila group was relatively earlier than that in the HT group and the HL group.

quote: After 16 days of feeding trial, the data presented in this study indicated that LAB diet had a positive effect on the mortality rate of crucian carp compared to that of HC group when the water temperature decreased.
statement: 经过16天的喂养试验，数据显示当水温下降时，与HC组相比，LAB日粮对鲫鱼的死亡率有积极影响。
text_zh: 经过16天的喂养试验，数据显示当水温下降时，与HC组相比，LAB日粮对鲫鱼的死亡率有积极影响。
text_en: After a 16-day feeding trial, the data showed that when water temperature decreased, the LAB diet had a positive effect on crucian carp mortality compared to the HC group.

quote: Every tank was equipped with a filter and an oxygen supply device, and the water temperature was maintained at 18 ± 1°C throughout the experiment.
statement: 每个水箱都配备了过滤器和供氧装置，整个实验期间水温保持在18±1°C。
text_zh: 每个水箱都配备了过滤器和供氧装置，整个实验期间水温保持在18±1°C。
text_en: Each tank was equipped with a filter and an oxygen supply device, and the water temperature was maintained at 18±1°C throughout the entire experiment.

quote: The averages of pH and dissolved oxygen values were pH 8.0 and 6.3 mg/L, respectively.
statement: pH值和溶解氧的平均值分别为8.0和6.3 mg/L。
text_zh: pH值和溶解氧的平均值分别为8.0和6.3 mg/L。
text_en: The average pH and dissolved oxygen were 8.0 and 6.3 mg/L, respectively.

quote: Fishes of all three groups were fed with common diets once daily at an amount that is 2% their body weight.
statement: 所有三组鱼每天喂食一次普通饲料，投喂量为体重的2%。
text_zh: 所有三组鱼每天喂食一次普通饲料，投喂量为体重的2%。
text_en: All three groups of fish were fed ordinary feed once daily at a rate of 2% of body weight.

quote: The HT and HL groups were fed with the prepared feed once every 2 days.
statement: HT组和HL组每两天喂食一次制备的饲料。
text_zh: HT组和HL组每两天喂食一次制备的饲料。
text_en: The HT group and the HL group were fed the prepared feed every two days.

quote: The fish survival conditions were recorded throughout the feeding experiment.
statement: 在整个喂养实验过程中记录了鱼的存活情况。
text_zh: 在整个喂养实验过程中记录了鱼的存活情况。
text_en: Fish survival was recorded throughout the entire feeding experiment.

quote: The fishes’ body surfaces were wiped with 75% alcohol cotton.
statement: 鱼体表用75%酒精棉擦拭。
text_zh: 鱼体表用75%酒精棉擦拭。
text_en: The fish body surface was wiped with 75% alcohol cotton.

quote: The levels of cytokines (as described above) in the gut were evaluated using ELISA kits (Beijing winter song Boyue Biotechnology Co., Ltd., China).
statement: 使用ELISA试剂盒评估肠道中上述细胞因子的水平。
text_zh: 使用ELISA试剂盒评估肠道中上述细胞因子的水平。
text_en: The levels of the aforementioned cytokines in the gut were assessed using an ELISA kit.

quote: Challenge Test With Aeromonas hydrophila ATCC 7,966 After the sample collection, crucian carp in all groups (HC, HT, and HL) were fed as before.
statement: 在样本采集后，所有组（HC、HT和HL）的鲫鱼继续按原方式饲喂，随后进行嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7,966攻毒试验。
text_zh: 在样本采集后，所有组（HC、HT和HL）的鲫鱼继续按原方式饲喂，随后进行嗜水气单胞菌ATCC 7,966攻毒试验。

quote: In the present study, dietary LAB showed anti-inflammatory effects on the intestine of fish via decreasing the concentration of pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-α and IL-1β, especially in the HT group.
statement: 本研究中，日粮添加乳酸菌（LAB）通过降低促炎细胞因子TNF-α和IL-1β的浓度，对鱼肠道表现出抗炎作用，尤其是在HT组中。
text_zh: 本研究中，日粮添加乳酸菌（LAB）通过降低促炎细胞因子TNF-α和IL-1β的浓度，对鱼肠道表现出抗炎作用，尤其是在HT组中。
text_en: In this study, dietary LAB supplementation showed anti-inflammatory effects on the fish intestine by reducing the concentrations of pro-inflammatory cytokines TNF-α and IL-1β, especially in the HT group.
outcome: 肠道炎症反应/免疫调节

quote: Our results showed that dietary LAB could decrease the concentration of TNF-α and IL-1β, which were consistent with that of Ou et al. (2019) .
statement: 研究结果表明，日粮添加乳酸菌可以降低TNF-α和IL-1β的浓度，这与Ou等人(2019)的结果一致。
text_zh: 研究结果表明，日粮添加乳酸菌可以降低TNF-α和IL-1β的浓度，这与Ou等人(2019)的结果一致。
text_en: The results showed that dietary LAB supplementation reduced the concentrations of TNF-α and IL-1β, which is consistent with the results of Ou et al. (2019).

quote: In this study, IL-6 was increased in the HT and HL groups.
statement: 在本研究中，HT组和HL组的IL-6水平升高。
text_zh: 在本研究中，HT组和HL组的IL-6水平升高。
text_en: In this study, IL-6 levels were elevated in the HT and HL groups.
counterevidence: IL-6作为促炎因子在特定组别中增加，可能与预期的抗炎效果不完全一致或反映复杂的免疫反应。

quote: These differences of proinflammatory cytokines can be influenced by intestinal microbiota.
statement: 这些促炎细胞因子的差异可能受到肠道微生物群的影响。
text_zh: 这些促炎细胞因子的差异可能受到肠道微生物群的影响。
text_en: The differences in these pro-inflammatory cytokines may be influenced by the gut microbiota.
outcome: 肠道微生物与免疫因子的关系

quote: IL-10 was increased only in the HL group, which indicated that this group had a better immune balance.
statement: 仅在HL组中IL-10水平升高，这表明该组具有更好的免疫平衡。
text_zh: 仅在HL组中IL-10水平升高，这表明该组具有更好的免疫平衡。
text_en: IL-10 levels increased only in the HL group, indicating better immune balance in this group.

quote: The probiotics, L. lactis 1,209 and L. lactis 1,242, showed the ability to adjust the composition of intestinal microbiota, stimulate secretes cytokines, and improve the survival rate and disease resistance against A. hydrophila in the crucian carp.
statement: 益生菌L. lactis 1,209和L. lactis 1,242能够调节肠道微生物群组成、刺激细胞因子分泌，并提高鲫鱼对嗜水气单胞菌的存活率和抗病力。
text_zh: 益生菌L. lactis 1,209和L. lactis 1,242能够调节肠道微生物群组成、刺激细胞因子分泌，并提高鲫鱼对嗜水气单胞菌的存活率和抗病力。

quote: In the present study, high-throughput analysis was used to investigate the dynamic changes of intestinal bacterial diversity under water temperature change and demonstrate beneficial effects of dietary LAB in gut compartments of crucian carp.
statement: 本研究利用高通量分析调查了水温变化下肠道细菌多样性的动态变化，并证明了饲料中乳酸菌（LAB）对鲫鱼肠道区室的有益影响。
text_zh: 本研究利用高通量分析调查了水温变化下肠道细菌多样性的动态变化，并证明了饲料中乳酸菌（LAB）对鲫鱼肠道区室的有益影响。
text_en: This study used high-throughput analysis to investigate the dynamic changes in gut bacterial diversity under water temperature variation, and demonstrated the beneficial effects of lactic acid bacteria (LAB) in feed on the intestinal compartments of crucian carp.

quote: In the present study, L. lactis 1,209 and L. lactis 1,242 were selected from the intestinal contents of Qinghai naked carp whose probiotic properties, including antibiotic sensitivity, gastrointestinal survival rate, bacteriostatic activity, bile salt tolerance, temperature range, high salt tolerance and so on, had been previously studied (Cui et al., 2018).
statement: 本研究中，从青海裸鲤肠道内容物中筛选出的乳酸乳球菌菌株L. lactis 1,209和L. lactis 1,242，其益生菌特性（包括抗生素敏感性、胃肠道存活率、抑菌活性、胆盐耐受性、温度范围和高盐耐受性等）已在先前的研究中得到证实。
text_zh: 本研究中，从青海裸鲤肠道内容物中筛选出的乳酸乳球菌菌株L. lactis 1,209和L. lactis 1,242，其益生菌特性（包括抗生素敏感性、胃肠道存活率、抑菌活性、胆盐耐受性、温度范围和高盐耐受性等）已在先前的研究中得到证实。

quote: The intestinal microflora affects physiological processes, immunological stress, and preventive infections in several hosts (Butt and Volkoff, 2019 ; Shi et al., 2020a).
statement: 肠道菌群影响多种宿主的生理过程、免疫应激和预防感染。
text_zh: 肠道菌群影响多种宿主的生理过程、免疫应激和预防感染。
text_en: The gut microbiota affects physiological processes, immune stress, and infection prevention in multiple hosts.

quote: LAB has been proven to be effective in modifying the host-associated intestinal microbiota (Xia et al., 2018 ; Ringo et al., 2020).
statement: 乳酸菌已被证明能有效改变宿主相关的肠道微生物群。
text_zh: 乳酸菌已被证明能有效改变宿主相关的肠道微生物群。
text_en: Lactic acid bacteria have been proven to effectively alter host-associated gut microbiota.

quote: However, it is not clear whether YG can play an important role in modifying intestinal microbiota of aquatic animals.
statement: 目前尚不清楚酵母葡聚糖是否能在改变水生动物肠道微生物群方面发挥重要作用。
text_zh: 目前尚不清楚酵母葡聚糖是否能在改变水生动物肠道微生物群方面发挥重要作用。
text_en: It is currently unclear whether yeast beta-glucan plays a significant role in altering the gut microbiota of aquatic animals.

quote: In fact, “winter mortalities” phenomenon has been reported at persistent low temperature during the winter.
statement: 持续低温期间已报道出现“冬季死亡”现象。
text_zh: 持续低温期间已报道出现“冬季死亡”现象。
text_en: "Winter mortality" has been reported during periods of sustained low temperature.

quote: The gradual reduction of water temperature often causes growth arrest and metabolic depression for a large number of fish species (Sánchez-Nuño et al., 2018a).
statement: 水温逐渐降低通常会导致许多鱼类生长停滞和代谢抑制。
text_zh: 水温逐渐降低通常会导致许多鱼类生长停滞和代谢抑制。
text_en: A gradual decrease in water temperature usually leads to growth stagnation and metabolic suppression in many fish species.

quote: Similarly, Sanchez-Nuno et al. also reported the “winter growth arrest,” where gilthead sea bream showed a doubling of feed conversion ratio (FCR) and a fourfold drop of specific growth rate (SGR) from 22°C to 14°C (Sánchez-Nuño et al., 2018b).
statement: 据报道，鲷鱼在从22°C降至14°C时表现出饲料转化率翻倍和特定生长率下降四倍。
text_zh: 据报道，鲷鱼在从22°C降至14°C时表现出饲料转化率翻倍和特定生长率下降四倍。
text_en: It is reported that sea bream showed a doubling of feed conversion ratio and a fourfold decrease in specific growth rate when the temperature was lowered from 22°C to 14°C.

quote: Accumulating evidence additionally indicated that low temperature contributed to susceptibility to diseases in cultured species (Ibarz et al., 2010).
statement: 越来越多的证据表明，低温增加了养殖物种对疾病的易感性。
text_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，低温增加了养殖物种对疾病的易感性。
text_en: There is increasing evidence that low temperature increases the susceptibility of farmed species to disease.

quote: In particular, previous studies have suggested that variations in temperature (also includes low temperature) shape the composition of the gut microbiota across the fish (Sánchez-Nuño et al., 2018a), and the gut microbiota gradually stabilizes as fish adapt to their environment.
statement: 先前的研究表明，温度变化塑造了鱼类肠道微生物群的组成，且随着鱼类适应环境，肠道微生物群逐渐稳定。
text_zh: 先前的研究表明，温度变化塑造了鱼类肠道微生物群的组成，且随着鱼类适应环境，肠道微生物群逐渐稳定。
text_en: Previous studies have shown that temperature changes shape the composition of fish gut microbiota, and as fish adapt to the environment, the gut microbiota gradually stabilizes.

quote: Therefore, assessing what impact feeding fish with LAB diets has on fish gut microbiota is essential to fully evaluate current aquaculture feeding strategies (Cláudia et al., 2021).
statement: 因此，评估喂食乳酸菌（LAB）日粮对鱼类肠道微生物群的影响对于全面评估当前的水产养殖喂养策略至关重要。
text_zh: 因此，评估喂食乳酸菌（LAB）日粮对鱼类肠道微生物群的影响对于全面评估当前的水产养殖喂养策略至关重要。
text_en: Therefore, evaluating the effects of feeding lactic acid bacteria (LAB) diets on fish gut microbiota is crucial for a comprehensive assessment of current aquaculture feeding strategies.

quote: Furthermore, considerable evidence shows that probiotics from the same autochthonous source have a great chance of colonizing the host gut, thereby bringing health benefits to the host (Sun et al., 2010 ; Mohammadian et al., 2016).
statement: 大量证据表明，来自相同土著源的益生菌有很大机会定植于宿主肠道，从而为宿主带来健康益处。
text_zh: 大量证据表明，来自相同土著源的益生菌有很大机会定植于宿主肠道，从而为宿主带来健康益处。
text_en: A large body of evidence indicates that probiotics from the same indigenous source have a high chance of colonizing the host gut, thereby bringing health benefits to the host.

quote: The concentration of IL-1β and IL-10 of all groups were higher at 5 day than at 0 day, and IL-10 in the HC group was significantly higher (p ≤ 0.05) between 5 days and 0 day.
statement: 所有组别在第5天的IL-1β和IL-10浓度均高于第0天，且HC组的IL-10在第5天与第0天之间差异显著（p ≤ 0.05）。
text_zh: 所有组别在第5天的IL-1β和IL-10浓度均高于第0天，且HC组的IL-10在第5天与第0天之间差异显著（p ≤ 0.05）。
text_en: IL-1β and IL-10 concentrations in all groups were higher on day 5 than on day 0, and the difference in IL-10 between day 5 and day 0 in the HC group was significant (p ≤ 0.05).

quote: The concentration of IFN-γ (Figure 4A) decreased with time, and the HT and HL groups were higher than that of HC group on the 15th day.
statement: IFN-γ浓度随时间降低，但在第15天，HT组和HL组的浓度高于HC组。
text_zh: IFN-γ浓度随时间降低，但在第15天，HT组和HL组的浓度高于HC组。
text_en: IFN-γ concentration decreased over time, but on day 15, the concentrations in the HT and HL groups were higher than in the HC group.

quote: From the results of HSP-70 (Figure 4B), it can be seen that the HT and HL groups were always lower than that of HC group, and the concentration of HT and HL groups on the 15th day were significantly lower than that of the HC group (p ≤ 0.05).
statement: HT组和HL组的HSP-70浓度始终低于HC组，且在第15天显著低于HC组（p ≤ 0.05）。
text_zh: HT组和HL组的HSP-70浓度始终低于HC组，且在第15天显著低于HC组（p ≤ 0.05）。
text_en: The HSP-70 concentrations in the HT and HL groups were consistently lower than those in the HC group, and were significantly lower than those in the HC group on day 15 (p ≤ 0.05).

quote: In general, IL-1β (Figure 4C) did not change significantly over time, and concentrations were highest at 5 days for all three groups.
statement: 总体而言，IL-1β随时间没有显著变化，三个组别的浓度均在第5天达到最高。
text_zh: 总体而言，IL-1β随时间没有显著变化，三个组别的浓度均在第5天达到最高。
text_en: Overall, IL-1β showed no significant change over time, with concentrations in all three groups peaking on day 5.

quote: The concentration of TNF-α (Figure 4D) decreased with time, the HT and HL groups were higher than that of HC group at 15 day, and the highest concentration was found in the HT group.
statement: TNF-α浓度随时间降低，但在第15天HT组和HL组高于HC组，且HT组浓度最高。
text_zh: TNF-α浓度随时间降低，但在第15天HT组和HL组高于HC组，且HT组浓度最高。
text_en: TNF-α concentration decreased over time, but on day 15 it was higher in the HT and HL groups than in the HC group, with the highest concentration in the HT group.

quote: Overall, the concentration of IL-10 (Figure 4E) increased with time, and the highest concentration was found in the HT group at 15 days, whereas HT group was highest on 10 days.
statement: 总体而言，IL-10浓度随时间增加，HT组在第15天浓度最高（注：原文此处表述存在矛盾，提及HT组在第10天也最高），而HT组在第10天也是最高的。
text_zh: 总体而言，IL-10浓度随时间增加，HT组在第15天浓度最高（注：原文此处表述存在矛盾，提及HT组在第10天也最高），而HT组在第10天也是最高的。
text_en: Overall, IL-10 concentration increased over time, with the HT group having the highest concentration on day 15 (Note: there is a contradiction in the original text, which also mentions that the HT group had the highest concentration on day 10), and the HT group also had the highest concentration on day 10.

quote: The concentration of IL-6 (Figure 4F) in the HC group was decreased, and the concentration of IL-6 in the HT and HL groups were higher than the HC group at 15 days.
statement: HC组的IL-6浓度降低，而在第15天，HT组和HL组的IL-6浓度高于HC组。
text_zh: HC组的IL-6浓度降低，而在第15天，HT组和HL组的IL-6浓度高于HC组。
text_en: IL-6 concentrations decreased in the HC group, while on day 15, IL-6 concentrations in the HT and HL groups were higher than in the HC group.

quote: In aquaculture, probiotic supplementation is known to alter the host’s gut microbial diversity (Wang et al., 2017 ; Niu et al., 2018).
statement: 在水产养殖中，已知补充益生菌会改变宿主的肠道微生物多样性。
text_zh: 在水产养殖中，已知补充益生菌会改变宿主的肠道微生物多样性。
text_en: In aquaculture, it is known that probiotic supplementation alters the host's gut microbial diversity.

quote: Jang et al. (2020) showed microbial diversity reduced compared to the initial group, and the probiotics treatment group had higher richness and diversity estimates than the control group of juvenile olive flounders (Paralichthys olivaceus).
statement: Jang等人(2020)的研究显示，与初始组相比微生物多样性降低，且益生菌处理组的幼体橄榄比目鱼（Paralichthys olivaceus）的丰富度和多样性估计值高于对照组。
text_zh: Jang等人(2020)的研究显示，与初始组相比微生物多样性降低，且益生菌处理组的幼体橄榄比目鱼（Paralichthys olivaceus）的丰富度和多样性估计值高于对照组。
text_en: Jang et al. (2020) showed that microbial diversity decreased compared to the initial group, and richness and diversity estimates of larval olive flounder (Paralichthys olivaceus) in the probiotic treatment group were higher than those in the control group.
outcome: 肠道微生物丰富度和多样性

quote: These results agreed with a recent study showing relative abundances of Firmicutes and rearing temperature have negative associations in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) (Huyben et al., 2018).
statement: 这些结果与最近的一项研究一致，该研究表明虹鳟鱼（Oncorhynchus mykiss）中厚壁菌门的相对丰度与饲养温度呈负相关。
text_zh: 这些结果与最近的一项研究一致，该研究表明虹鳟鱼（Oncorhynchus mykiss）中厚壁菌门的相对丰度与饲养温度呈负相关。
text_en: These results are consistent with a recent study showing that the relative abundance of Firmicutes in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss) is negatively correlated with rearing temperature.

quote: Moreover, a previous study has shown that many of the compositional changes in the fish gut microbiota in response to temperature change that have been observed are driven by shifts in the relative abundances of Proteobacteria lineages in all fish species (Sepulveda and Moeller, 2020).
statement: 此外，先前的研究表明，观察到的鱼类肠道微生物群响应温度变化的许多组成变化是由所有鱼类物种中变形菌门谱系相对丰度的变化驱动的。
text_zh: 此外，先前的研究表明，观察到的鱼类肠道微生物群响应温度变化的许多组成变化是由所有鱼类物种中变形菌门谱系相对丰度的变化驱动的。
text_en: In addition, previous studies have shown that many of the observed compositional changes in fish gut microbiota in response to temperature variation are driven by changes in the relative abundance of Proteobacteria lineages across all fish species.
outcome: 肠道微生物群组成变化

quote: Fish were allowed to acclimate to laboratory conditions for about 2 weeks before artificial infection.
statement: 鱼类在人工感染前被允许适应实验室条件约两周。
text_zh: 鱼类在人工感染前被允许适应实验室条件约两周。
text_en: Fish were allowed to acclimate to laboratory conditions for about two weeks before artificial infection.

quote: Fish were kept in rearing tanks supplied with running water at 25 ± 2°C and fed daily with basal diet (Xu, Wang, Li, & Lin, 2009).
statement: 鱼类饲养在提供流水的养殖缸中，温度为25±2°C，并每日喂食基础日粮。
text_zh: 鱼类饲养在提供流水的养殖缸中，温度为25±2°C，并每日喂食基础日粮。
text_en: Fish were reared in raceways providing flowing water, at a temperature of 25±2°C, and fed a basal diet daily.

quote: Accordingly, these data suggested that the crucian carp feed with or without LAB affected the proportion of bacteria in the intestine, and the dominant bacteria in the LAB treated group tended to be evenly distributed and tended toward healthy levels.
statement: 数据表明，饲喂含或不含乳酸菌的饲料影响了鲫鱼肠道中细菌的比例，且乳酸菌处理组中的优势菌分布更均匀并趋向健康水平。
text_zh: 数据表明，饲喂含或不含乳酸菌的饲料影响了鲫鱼肠道中细菌的比例，且乳酸菌处理组中的优势菌分布更均匀并趋向健康水平。
text_en: Data indicate that feeding diets with or without lactic acid bacteria affected the proportion of bacteria in the gut of crucian carp, and the distribution of dominant bacteria in the lactic acid bacteria treatment group was more uniform and tended towards healthy levels.
outcome: 肠道菌群平衡与健康状态

quote: In conclusion, LAB for the feed additives can change the intestinal microbiota of crucian carp by regulating the balance of intestinal microbial ecosystem structure under the condition of temperature change.
statement: 总之，作为饲料添加剂的乳酸菌可以通过在温度变化条件下调节肠道微生物生态系统结构的平衡来改变鲫鱼的肠道微生物群。
text_zh: 总之，作为饲料添加剂的乳酸菌可以通过在温度变化条件下调节肠道微生物生态系统结构的平衡来改变鲫鱼的肠道微生物群。
text_en: In summary, lactic acid bacteria as feed additives can alter the gut microbiota of crucian carp by regulating the balance of the gut microbial ecosystem structure under temperature change conditions.

quote: several studies showed that LAB and other probiotics can electively regulate the expression of proinflammatory and inflammatory cytokines including tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-α, interleukin IL-6, IL-1β, IL-10, and interferon (IFN)-γ which are commonly used as reference genes in immunomodulatory studies (Galindo-Villegas et al., 2012 ; Ashraf et al., 2014 ; Angela et al., 2020).
statement: 多项研究表明，乳酸菌和其他益生菌可以选择性地调节促炎和炎症细胞因子（包括TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IL-10和IFN-γ）的表达。
text_zh: 多项研究表明，乳酸菌和其他益生菌可以选择性地调节促炎和炎症细胞因子（包括TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IL-10和IFN-γ）的表达。
text_en: Multiple studies have shown that lactic acid bacteria and other probiotics can selectively regulate the expression of pro-inflammatory and inflammatory cytokines (including TNF-α, IL-6, IL-1β, IL-10, and IFN-γ).

quote: On the other hand, immunomodulatory effects of LAB as a feed additive have recently received increasing attention as potential selection parameters for probiotics (Feng et al., 2016 , 2019 ; Giri et al., 2016).
statement: 另一方面，乳酸菌作为饲料添加剂的免疫调节作用最近受到越来越多的关注，被视为益生菌的潜在选择参数。
text_zh: 另一方面，乳酸菌作为饲料添加剂的免疫调节作用最近受到越来越多的关注，被视为益生菌的潜在选择参数。
text_en: On the other hand, the immunomodulatory effect of lactic acid bacteria as feed additives has recently received increasing attention and is regarded as a potential selection parameter for probiotics.

quote: tary oligochitosan could significantly improve the growth performance and enhance in resistance against A. hydrophila of tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) by reducing the levels of mRNAs encoding the stress-response HSP-70 and the pro-inflammatory protein TNF-α, while the diets increased the pro-inflammatory protein TNF-β (Shi et al., 2020a).
statement: 膳食低聚壳聚糖可通过降低应激反应HSP-70和促炎蛋白TNF-α的mRNA水平，同时增加促炎蛋白TNF-β，显著改善罗非鱼的生长性能并增强其对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力。
text_zh: 膳食低聚壳聚糖可通过降低应激反应HSP-70和促炎蛋白TNF-α的mRNA水平，同时增加促炎蛋白TNF-β，显著改善罗非鱼的生长性能并增强其对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力。
text_en: Dietary low-molecular-weight chitosan oligosaccharide significantly improved the growth performance of tilapia and enhanced its resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila by reducing the mRNA levels of the stress-response protein HSP-70 and the pro-inflammatory protein TNF-α, while increasing the pro-inflammatory protein TNF-β.
outcome: 生长性能、抗病力及炎症/应激指标

quote: Moreover, Shi et al. (2020b) showed that grass carp treated with the probiotic B. subtilis H2 revealed a significantly improved immune response in terms of upregulated mRNA levels of inflammatory cytokines IL-11, TNF-α, and IL-8.
statement: 用益生菌枯草芽孢杆菌H2处理的草鱼表现出免疫反应显著改善，具体体现为炎症细胞因子IL-11、TNF-α和IL-8的mRNA水平上调。
text_zh: 用益生菌枯草芽孢杆菌H2处理的草鱼表现出免疫反应显著改善，具体体现为炎症细胞因子IL-11、TNF-α和IL-8的mRNA水平上调。
text_en: Grass carp treated with the probiotic Bacillus subtilis H2 showed significantly improved immune responses, specifically manifested as upregulated mRNA levels of the inflammatory cytokines IL-11, TNF-α, and IL-8.

quote: These inconsistent results could be manipulated by a number of factors, such as the water environment factors, the health status of animals, and the usage mode, dosage, and time of applying the probiotics.
statement: 益生菌应用结果的不一致性可能受水环境因素、动物健康状况以及益生菌的使用方式、剂量和时间等因素的影响。
text_zh: 益生菌应用结果的不一致性可能受水环境因素、动物健康状况以及益生菌的使用方式、剂量和时间等因素的影响。
text_en: The inconsistency of probiotic application results may be influenced by factors such as water environmental conditions, animal health status, and the method, dosage, and timing of probiotic use.
limitations: 水环境因素、动物健康状况、使用方式、剂量和时间

quote: The activity and composition of intestinal microbiota influences intestinal environments, and therefore cytokines profiles in intestinal content (Liu et al., 2013) which exert vital influence on intestinal health.
statement: 肠道微生物群的活性和组成影响肠道环境，进而影响肠内容物中的细胞因子谱，这对肠道健康具有重要影响。
text_zh: 肠道微生物群的活性和组成影响肠道环境，进而影响肠内容物中的细胞因子谱，这对肠道健康具有重要影响。
text_en: The activity and composition of the gut microbiota affect the gut environment, which in turn affects the cytokine profile in intestinal contents, having an important impact on gut health.

quote: For example, Jang et al. (2020) reported that probiotics inspired pro-inflammatory responses by promoting proinflammatory (TNF-α, IL-6, and IL-1β) and anti-inflammatory cytokine (IL-10) production.
statement: Jang等人（2020）报道，益生菌通过促进促炎细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β）和抗炎细胞因子（IL-10）的产生来激发促炎反应。
text_zh: Jang等人（2020）报道，益生菌通过促进促炎细胞因子（TNF-α、IL-6和IL-1β）和抗炎细胞因子（IL-10）的产生来激发促炎反应。
text_en: Jang et al. (2020) reported that probiotics stimulate pro-inflammatory responses by promoting the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines (TNF-α, IL-6 and IL-1β) and anti-inflammatory cytokines (IL-10).

quote: A pre‐experiment lasting for 1 month was carried out to confirm the safety of YG on C. gibelio when fed with a basal diet containing 800 mg/kg YG, and we found that the survival rate was 100%, no other symptoms were observed
statement: 在含有800毫克/千克YG的基础日粮中喂养鲫鱼（C. gibelio）一个月，存活率为100%，未观察到其他症状。
text_zh: 在含有800毫克/千克YG的基础日粮中喂养鲫鱼（C. gibelio）一个月，存活率为100%，未观察到其他症状。
text_en: Feeding crucian carp (C. gibelio) for one month on a basal diet containing 800 mg/kg YG resulted in a survival rate of 100%, with no other symptoms observed.

quote: we concluded that YG is safe to C. gibelio when fed with a basal diet containing 800 mg/kg YG.
statement: 作者得出结论，当以含有800毫克/千克YG的基础日粮喂养时，YG对鲫鱼是安全的。
text_zh: 作者得出结论，当以含有800毫克/千克YG的基础日粮喂养时，YG对鲫鱼是安全的。
text_en: The authors concluded that YG is safe for crucian carp when fed a basal diet containing 800 mg/kg YG.

quote: For instance, the intestinal microflora of yellowtail kingfish (Seriola lalandi) found that increasing temperatures were associated with shifts in the relative abundances of Gammaproteobacteria lineages (Soriano et al., 2018).
statement: 黄条鰤的肠道微生物研究表明，温度升高与γ-变形菌纲谱系相对丰度的变化有关。
text_zh: 黄条鰤的肠道微生物研究表明，温度升高与γ-变形菌纲谱系相对丰度的变化有关。
text_en: Studies on the gut microbiota of yellowtail amberjack indicate that temperature increase is associated with changes in the relative abundance of Gammaproteobacteria lineages.

quote: Similar shifts in Gammaproteobacteria abundances have been observed in salmon (Salmo salar).
statement: 在大西洋鲑中也观察到了类似的γ-变形菌纲丰度变化。
text_zh: 在大西洋鲑中也观察到了类似的γ-变形菌纲丰度变化。
text_en: Similar changes in the abundance of Gammaproteobacteria were also observed in Atlantic salmon.

quote: In addition, it was found that increasing temperatures were associated with decreases in the relative abundances of Acinetobacter , consistent with our results (Neuman et al., 2016).
statement: 研究发现温度升高与不动杆菌属相对丰度降低有关，这与本研究结果一致。
text_zh: 研究发现温度升高与不动杆菌属相对丰度降低有关，这与本研究结果一致。
text_en: The study found that temperature increase was associated with a decrease in the relative abundance of Acinetobacter, which is consistent with the results of this study.

quote: It is evident that LAB diet plays an important role in maintaining the intestinal microflora ecosystem in crucian carp under the water temperature decrease.
statement: 乳酸菌饲料在低温条件下对维持鲫鱼肠道微生态系统具有重要作用。
text_zh: 乳酸菌饲料在低温条件下对维持鲫鱼肠道微生态系统具有重要作用。
text_en: Lactic acid bacteria feed plays an important role in maintaining the intestinal microecosystem of crucian carp under low-temperature conditions.

quote: Furthermore, at the genus level, Cetobacteria , Lactobacillus , and Aeromonas increased in the HT and HL groups.
statement: 在属水平上，HT和HL组中的鲸杆菌属、乳杆菌属和气单胞菌属增加。
text_zh: 在属水平上，HT和HL组中的鲸杆菌属、乳杆菌属和气单胞菌属增加。
text_en: At the genus level, Cetobacterium, Lactobacillus, and Aeromonas increased in the HT and HL groups.
intervention_record: 温度结合乳酸菌饲料处理

quote: In particular, the Lactobacillus in HT group increased the most, and compared with the HC group, Acinetobacter , Burkholderia , and Aurantimicrobium decreased in the HT and HL groups.
statement: 特别是HT组的乳杆菌增加最多；与HC组相比，HT和HL组中的不动杆菌属、伯克霍尔德菌属和金微菌属减少。
text_zh: 特别是HT组的乳杆菌增加最多；与HC组相比，HT和HL组中的不动杆菌属、伯克霍尔德菌属和金微菌属减少。
text_en: In particular, Lactobacillus increased the most in the HT group; compared with the HC group, Acinetobacter, Burkholderia, and Chryseobacterium decreased in the HT and HL groups.
intervention_record: 温度结合乳酸菌饲料处理
counterevidence: 部分潜在致病菌或条件致病菌（如气单胞菌）增加，但其他菌属减少

quote: Based on the assumption that the synergistic effect of YG might strengthen the immune function and intestinal microbiota, we hypothesized that YG may be a suitable alternative to antibiotics and reach the similar effects without negative impact when added in the basal diet of aquatic animals.
statement: 基于YG的协同效应可能增强免疫功能和肠道微生物群的假设，作者提出YG可能是抗生素的合适替代品，在水生动物基础日粮中添加时能达到类似效果且无负面影响。
text_zh: 基于YG的协同效应可能增强免疫功能和肠道微生物群的假设，作者提出YG可能是抗生素的合适替代品，在水生动物基础日粮中添加时能达到类似效果且无负面影响。
text_en: Based on the hypothesis that the synergistic effect of YG may enhance immune function and gut microbiota, the authors propose that YG may be a suitable alternative to antibiotics, achieving similar effects without negative impacts when added to the basal diet of aquatic animals.
outcome: 免疫功能与肠道微生物群

quote: To test the in vivo antimicrobial effect of YG, intestine microbial community of Carassius auratus gibelio feeding with a basal diet containing antibiotics and YG was determined by 16S rRNA sequencing.
statement: 为了测试YG体内的抗菌效果，通过16S rRNA测序确定了喂食含抗生素和YG的基础日粮的异育银鲫的肠道微生物群落。
text_zh: 为了测试YG体内的抗菌效果，通过16S rRNA测序确定了喂食含抗生素和YG的基础日粮的异育银鲫的肠道微生物群落。
text_en: To test the antibacterial effect of YG, the gut microbiota of gibel carp fed a basal diet containing antibiotics and YG was determined by 16S rRNA sequencing.

quote: Hepatic adenylate kinase (AK), pyruvate kinase (PK) and adenosine triphosphate (ATP) activities in both infected and uninfected liver of C. gibelio were measured according to the published methods
statement: 根据已发表的方法测量了感染和未感染的鲤鲫肝脏中的腺苷酸激酶（AK）、丙酮酸激酶（PK）和三磷酸腺苷（ATP）活性。
text_zh: 根据已发表的方法测量了感染和未感染的鲤鲫肝脏中的腺苷酸激酶（AK）、丙酮酸激酶（PK）和三磷酸腺苷（ATP）活性。
text_en: Adenylate kinase (AK), pyruvate kinase (PK), and adenosine triphosphate (ATP) activities in the livers of infected and uninfected carp were measured according to published methods.

quote: Antibiotic sensitivity was tested by Disc Diffusion Method
statement: 通过纸片扩散法测试抗生素敏感性。
text_zh: 通过纸片扩散法测试抗生素敏感性。
text_en: Antibiotic susceptibility was tested by the disk diffusion method.

quote: In our study, there was no significant difference in INF-γ concentration among the groups
statement: 本研究中各组间INF-γ浓度无显著差异。
text_zh: 本研究中各组间INF-γ浓度无显著差异。
text_en: There was no significant difference in INF-γ concentration between the groups in this study.
outcome: 免疫反应/细胞因子水平

quote: HSP-70 was decreased in the HT and HL groups compared with the control group.
statement: 与对照组相比，HT和HL组的HSP-70降低。
text_zh: 与对照组相比，HT和HL组的HSP-70降低。
text_en: Compared with the control group, HSP-70 decreased in the HT and HL groups.

quote: the mRNA expression levels of HSP-70 were increased of the Nile tilapia when exposed to toxicants and stressors
statement: 尼罗罗非鱼暴露于有毒物质和应激源时，HSP-70的mRNA表达水平增加。
text_zh: 尼罗罗非鱼暴露于有毒物质和应激源时，HSP-70的mRNA表达水平增加。
text_en: When Nile tilapia are exposed to toxic substances and stressors, the mRNA expression level of HSP-70 increases.

quote: these results suggest that the addition of LAB to the diet can stimulate the intestinal immune reaction of crucian carp.
statement: 这些结果表明，日粮中添加乳酸菌可以刺激鲫鱼的肠道免疫反应。
text_zh: 这些结果表明，日粮中添加乳酸菌可以刺激鲫鱼的肠道免疫反应。
text_en: These results indicate that the addition of lactic acid bacteria to the diet can stimulate intestinal immune responses in crucian carp.

quote: However, in aquaculture, the effects of dietary supplementation of probiotics on cytokines have been extensively studied, but results and expression levels have been inconsistent among many reports.
statement: 然而，在水产养殖中，虽然已广泛研究了膳食补充益生菌对细胞因子的影响，但许多报告中的结果和表达水平并不一致。
text_zh: 然而，在水产养殖中，虽然已广泛研究了膳食补充益生菌对细胞因子的影响，但许多报告中的结果和表达水平并不一致。
text_en: However, in aquaculture, although the effects of dietary probiotic supplementation on cytokines have been widely studied, the results and expression levels reported in many studies are inconsistent.

quote: dietary L. casei BL23 could significantly increase the survival rate of zebrafish against A. hydrophila by enhancing the levels of anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 and pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1β and TNF-α at mRNA levels
statement: 日粮中的L. casei BL23可通过在mRNA水平上增强抗炎细胞因子IL-10和促炎细胞因子IL-1β及TNF-α的水平，显著提高斑马鱼对抗嗜水气单胞菌的存活率。
text_zh: 日粮中的L. casei BL23可通过在mRNA水平上增强抗炎细胞因子IL-10和促炎细胞因子IL-1β及TNF-α的水平，显著提高斑马鱼对抗嗜水气单胞菌的存活率。
text_en: Dietary L. casei BL23 significantly improved the survival rate of zebrafish against Aeromonas hydrophila by enhancing the mRNA levels of anti-inflammatory cytokine IL-10 and pro-inflammatory cytokines IL-1β and TNF-α.

quote: Qin et al. (2014) demonstrated that the dietary oligochitosan could significantly improve the growth performance and enhance in resistance against A. hydrophila of tilapia (Oreochromis niloticus) by reducing the levels of mRNAs encoding the stress-response HSP-70 and the pro-inflammatory protein TNF-α
statement: Qin等人(2014)证明，日粮中的低聚壳聚糖可以通过降低编码应激反应HSP-70和促炎蛋白TNF-α的mRNA水平，显著改善罗非鱼的生长性能并增强其对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力。
text_zh: Qin等人(2014)证明，日粮中的低聚壳聚糖可以通过降低编码应激反应HSP-70和促炎蛋白TNF-α的mRNA水平，显著改善罗非鱼的生长性能并增强其对嗜水气单胞菌的抵抗力。
text_en: Qin et al. (2014) demonstrated that dietary chitosan oligosaccharide significantly improved the growth performance of tilapia and enhanced its resistance to Aeromonas hydrophila by reducing mRNA levels encoding the stress response protein HSP-70 and the pro-inflammatory protein TNF-α.

quote: Aetiological agent was re‐isolated and identified according to the above‐mentioned methods, and mortality was recorded for calculating median lethal dose (LD50).
statement: 根据上述方法重新分离并鉴定了病原体，并记录死亡率以计算半数致死量（LD50）。
text_zh: 根据上述方法重新分离并鉴定了病原体，并记录死亡率以计算半数致死量（LD50）。
text_en: The pathogen was re-isolated and identified according to the above method, and mortality was recorded to calculate the median lethal dose (LD50).

quote: For five experimental groups, fish were injected intramuscularly with 500 μl of serially diluted bacteria suspension (1 × 10 5 , 1 × 10 6 , 1 × 10 7 , 1 × 10 8 and 1 × 10 9 CFU/ml), respectively.
statement: 对于五个实验组，分别向鱼体内肌肉注射500微升系列稀释的细菌悬浮液（1×10^5至1×10^9 CFU/ml）。
text_zh: 对于五个实验组，分别向鱼体内肌肉注射500微升系列稀释的细菌悬浮液（1×10^5至1×10^9 CFU/ml）。
text_en: For the five experimental groups, fish were intramuscularly injected with 500 microliters of serially diluted bacterial suspension (1×10^5 to 1×10^9 CFU/ml).

quote: Signs were observed twice a day and mortality was recorded for 2 weeks, then LD50 was calculated based on Reed method (Reed & Muench, 1938).
statement: 每天观察两次症状并记录死亡情况持续2周，然后根据Reed方法计算LD50。
text_zh: 每天观察两次症状并记录死亡情况持续2周，然后根据Reed方法计算LD50。
text_en: Symptoms were observed twice daily and deaths recorded for 2 weeks, then LD50 was calculated according to the Reed method.

quote: ATP levels in livers also showed an obvious decrease (42.8%, p 2d).
statement: 患病鲫鱼肝脏中的三磷酸腺苷（ATP）水平明显下降，降幅为42.8%。
text_zh: 患病鲫鱼肝脏中的三磷酸腺苷（ATP）水平明显下降，降幅为42.8%。
text_en: The adenosine triphosphate (ATP) level in the liver of diseased crucian carp decreased significantly, with a reduction of 42.8%.

quote: the results showed that A. caviae was sensitive to seven drugs, including ceftazidime, cefotaxime, vancomycin, nitrofurantoin, aztreonam, rifampicin and amikacin (Table 2).
statement: 药敏试验结果显示，Aeromonas caviae对头孢他啶、头孢噻肟、万古霉素、呋喃妥因、氨曲南、利福平和阿米卡星这七种药物敏感。
text_zh: 药敏试验结果显示，Aeromonas caviae对头孢他啶、头孢噻肟、万古霉素、呋喃妥因、氨曲南、利福平和阿米卡星这七种药物敏感。
text_en: Antimicrobial susceptibility testing results showed that Aeromonas caviae was sensitive to seven drugs: ceftazidime, cefotaxime, vancomycin, nitrofurantoin, aztreonam, rifampicin, and amikacin.

quote: After inoculation at 28°C for 24 hr, bacterial turbidity significantly decreased in tube 1–3 compared with tube 10 (positive control), and turbidit
statement: 在28°C接种培养24小时后，与阳性对照管相比，1-3号管中的细菌浊度显著降低。
text_zh: 在28°C接种培养24小时后，与阳性对照管相比，1-3号管中的细菌浊度显著降低。
text_en: After inoculation and culture at 28°C for 24 hours, bacterial turbidity in tubes 1-3 was significantly reduced compared to the positive control tube.

quote: Aeromonas became the dominant bacteria post–artificial infection (NC group) compared with BC group, and YG supplement (YG group) could more significantly decreased (p Aeromonas than antibiotic group (PC group) did.
statement: 与空白对照组相比，人工感染后气单胞菌成为优势菌群，且补充YG的组比抗生素组更显著地降低了气单胞菌的数量。
text_zh: 与空白对照组相比，人工感染后气单胞菌成为优势菌群，且补充YG的组比抗生素组更显著地降低了气单胞菌的数量。
text_en: Compared with the blank control group, Aeromonas became the dominant microbiota after artificial infection, and the YG-supplemented group reduced the number of Aeromonas more significantly than the antibiotic group.

quote: Propelled by ciliary movement, the parasite migrates beneath the skin or resides in localized areas, inducing tissue hyperplasia and excessive mucus production [ 1 ].
statement: 寄生虫通过纤毛运动迁移至皮下或停留在局部区域，诱导组织增生和过量黏液分泌。
text_zh: 寄生虫通过纤毛运动迁移至皮下或停留在局部区域，诱导组织增生和过量黏液分泌。
text_en: Parasites migrate to the subcutaneous tissue or remain in local areas through ciliary movement, inducing tissue hyperplasia and excessive mucus secretion.
outcome: 病理反应（组织增生、黏液分泌）

quote: In past decades, antibiotics have been used in animal feed to reduce bacterial infections.
statement: 过去几十年中，抗生素被用于动物饲料以减少细菌感染。
text_zh: 过去几十年中，抗生素被用于动物饲料以减少细菌感染。
text_en: Over the past few decades, antibiotics have been used in animal feed to reduce bacterial infections.

quote: However, this relative practice has been banned in the European Union and United States of America (Pradella, 2006), and become increasingly controversial in the world considering the possible adverse effects of antibiotics, such as developing of resistance strains, contaminating the environment, posing threat to food safety and predisposing to later intestinal disease for reduction in microbial diversity (Cotten et al., 2009 ; Phillips et al., 2004 ; Young & Schmidt, 2004).
statement: 由于抗生素可能导致耐药菌株发展、环境污染、食品安全威胁以及因微生物多样性减少而引发的后期肠道疾病等潜在副作用，这种做法在欧盟和美国已被禁止，并在全球范围内日益引起争议。
text_zh: 由于抗生素可能导致耐药菌株发展、环境污染、食品安全威胁以及因微生物多样性减少而引发的后期肠道疾病等潜在副作用，这种做法在欧盟和美国已被禁止，并在全球范围内日益引起争议。
text_en: Due to potential side effects such as the development of antibiotic-resistant strains, environmental pollution, food safety threats, and late-onset intestinal diseases caused by reduced microbial diversity, this practice has been banned in the European Union and the United States and is increasingly controversial worldwide.
outcome: 耐药性、环境安全、肠道健康
counterevidence: 导致耐药菌株、环境污染、食品安全威胁及肠道疾病风险

quote: China Ministry of Agriculture has gradually reduced types and doses of antibiotics allowed in feed since 2017 with the intent to ban the usage of antibiotics as animal feed additives by 2020.
statement: 中国农业部自2017年起逐步减少允许在饲料中使用的抗生素种类和剂量，并计划于2020年禁止将抗生素用作动物饲料添加剂。
text_zh: 中国农业部自2017年起逐步减少允许在饲料中使用的抗生素种类和剂量，并计划于2020年禁止将抗生素用作动物饲料添加剂。
text_en: Since 2017, China's Ministry of Agriculture has gradually reduced the types and dosages of antibiotics permitted for use in feed, and plans to ban the use of antibiotics as animal feed additives by 2020.

quote: Thus, finding safe and effective alternatives to traditional antibiotics in aquaculture are needed.
statement: 因此，需要在水产养殖中寻找传统抗生素的安全有效替代品。
text_zh: 因此，需要在水产养殖中寻找传统抗生素的安全有效替代品。
text_en: Therefore, it is necessary to find safe and effective alternatives to traditional antibiotics in aquaculture.

quote: Although a lot of attempts have been made over the years, such as using vaccine, probiotics and immunostimulants (Munir, Hashim, Nor, & Marsh, 2018 ; Wang et al., 2019), the effective alternatives to antibiotics in aquaculture are still to be developed.
statement: 尽管多年来已尝试使用疫苗、益生菌和免疫刺激剂等方法，但水产养殖中有效的抗生素替代品仍有待开发。
text_zh: 尽管多年来已尝试使用疫苗、益生菌和免疫刺激剂等方法，但水产养殖中有效的抗生素替代品仍有待开发。
text_en: Although vaccines, probiotics and immunostimulants have been tried for many years, effective antibiotic alternatives in aquaculture still need to be developed.
intervention_record: 疫苗、益生菌、免疫刺激剂
limitations: 尚未开发出完全有效的替代品

quote: Yeast glycoprotein (YG) containing glycoprotein and cell wall polysaccharides may increase resistance to infections by Gram‐negative bacteria, and serve as an immunomodulator because the internal β‐dextran can modify immunosuppression (Amorim et al., 2012 ; Qin et al., 2019).
statement: 含有糖蛋白和细胞壁多糖的酵母糖蛋白（YG）可能增加对革兰氏阴性菌感染的抵抗力，并可作为免疫调节剂，因为其内部的β-葡聚糖可以修饰免疫抑制。
text_zh: 含有糖蛋白和细胞壁多糖的酵母糖蛋白（YG）可能增加对革兰氏阴性菌感染的抵抗力，并可作为免疫调节剂，因为其内部的β-葡聚糖可以修饰免疫抑制。
text_en: Yeast glycan (YG), containing glycoproteins and cell wall polysaccharides, may increase resistance to Gram-negative bacterial infections and act as an immunomodulator because its internal β-glucans can modify immunosuppression.

quote: This study aimed to investigate the antimicrobial activity of yeast glycoprotein (YG) against Aeromonas caviae .
statement: 本研究旨在研究酵母糖蛋白（YG）对卡氏气单胞菌的抗菌活性。
text_zh: 本研究旨在研究酵母糖蛋白（YG）对卡氏气单胞菌的抗菌活性。
text_en: This study aims to investigate the antibacterial activity of yeast glycoprotein (YG) against Aeromonas salmonicida.

quote: Further pathogenicity analysis revealed that A. caviae possessed β‐haemolysis, and its median lethal dose for C. gibelio was 1.33 × 10 6 CFU/ml.
statement: 进一步的致病性分析显示，A. caviae具有β-溶血性，其对C. gibelio的半数致死剂量为1.33 × 10^6 CFU/ml。
text_zh: 进一步的致病性分析显示，A. caviae具有β-溶血性，其对C. gibelio的半数致死剂量为1.33 × 10^6 CFU/ml。
text_en: Further pathogenicity analysis showed that A. caviae has β-hemolytic activity, and its median lethal dose for C. gibelio is 1.33 × 10^6 CFU/ml.

quote: Hepatic adenylate kinase and pyruvate kinase activities of C. gibelio were inhibited post– A. caviae infection.
statement: 感染A. caviae后，C. gibelio肝脏中的腺苷酸激酶和丙酮酸激酶活性受到抑制。
text_zh: 感染A. caviae后，C. gibelio肝脏中的腺苷酸激酶和丙酮酸激酶活性受到抑制。
text_en: After infection with A. caviae, the activities of adenylate kinase and pyruvate kinase in the liver of C. gibelio were inhibited.
outcome: 肝脏酶活性与健康状况

quote: Minimum inhibitory and bactericidal concentration of YG was 83.3 mg/ml and 166.7 mg/ml, respectively.
statement: YG的最小抑菌浓度和最小杀菌浓度分别为83.3 mg/ml和166.7 mg/ml。
text_zh: YG的最小抑菌浓度和最小杀菌浓度分别为83.3 mg/ml和166.7 mg/ml。
text_en: The minimum inhibitory concentration and minimum bactericidal concentration of YG are 83.3 mg/ml and 166.7 mg/ml, respectively.

quote: Microbiota sequencing results showed that YG supplement could obviously decrease the relative abundance of Aeromonas and increase the microbial diversity.
statement: 微生物组测序结果显示，补充YG可明显降低气单胞菌的相对丰度并增加微生物多样性。
text_zh: 微生物组测序结果显示，补充YG可明显降低气单胞菌的相对丰度并增加微生物多样性。
text_en: Microbiome sequencing results showed that supplementation with YG significantly reduced the relative abundance of Aeromonas and increased microbial diversity.
outcome: 肠道菌群组成与多样性

quote: Our study revealed that A. caviae from C. gibelio was a multidrug‐resistant bacteria strain, and could be significantly inhibited by YG in vivo and in vitro, thus providing important insights into ecological control and pathogenesis of A. caviae in aquaculture.
statement: 我们的研究表明，来自C. gibelio的A. caviae是一种多重耐药菌株，可在体内和体外被YG显著抑制，从而为水产养殖中A. caviae的生态控制和发病机制提供了重要见解。
text_zh: 我们的研究表明，来自C. gibelio的A. caviae是一种多重耐药菌株，可在体内和体外被YG显著抑制，从而为水产养殖中A. caviae的生态控制和发病机制提供了重要见解。
text_en: Our study shows that A. caviae from C. gibelio is a multidrug-resistant strain that can be significantly inhibited by YG both in vivo and in vitro, providing important insights into the ecological control and pathogenesis of A. caviae in aquaculture.

quote: Reproduction of infection demonstrated that normal C. gibelio was susceptible to A. caviae infection, the LD50 of A. caviae for C. gibelio is 1.33 × 10 6 CFU/ml, indicating that A. caviae was highly virulent to C. gibelio .
statement: 感染复现实验表明正常异育银鲫对维氏气单胞菌易感，其LD50为1.33 × 10^6 CFU/ml，显示该菌对异育银鲫具有高毒力。
text_zh: 感染复现实验表明正常异育银鲫对维氏气单胞菌易感，其LD50为1.33 × 10^6 CFU/ml，显示该菌对异育银鲫具有高毒力。
text_en: Reinfection experiments showed that normal gibel carp are susceptible to Aeromonas veronii, with an LD50 of 1.33 × 10^6 CFU/ml, indicating that this bacterium has high virulence to gibel carp.

quote: Aeromonas caviae isolated from C. gibelio was a type of multiple antibiotic‐resistant bacteria strain and highly virulent to C. gibelio.
statement: 从银鲫中分离出的气单胞菌是一种多重耐药菌株，对银鲫具有高毒力。
text_zh: 从银鲫中分离出的气单胞菌是一种多重耐药菌株，对银鲫具有高毒力。
text_en: Aeromonas isolated from gibel carp is a multidrug-resistant strain with high virulence to gibel carp.

quote: Fortunately, it could be effectively inhibited by YG in vivo and in vitro, providing a potentially safe and effective alternative method to traditional antibiotics.
statement: YG在体内和体外均能有效抑制该细菌，提供了一种潜在的安全有效的传统抗生素替代方法。
text_zh: YG在体内和体外均能有效抑制该细菌，提供了一种潜在的安全有效的传统抗生素替代方法。
text_en: YG effectively inhibited this bacterium both in vivo and in vitro, providing a potential safe and effective alternative to traditional antibiotics.

quote: Before sacrificing and handling, experimental C. gibelio were anesthetized with ethyl 3‐aminobenzoate methanesulfonic acid (MS222, Sigma, USA), and all efforts were made to minimize suffering.
statement: 在处死和处理前，实验用银鲫使用乙基-3-氨基苯甲酸甲磺酸（MS222）进行麻醉，并尽力减少痛苦。
text_zh: 在处死和处理前，实验用银鲫使用乙基-3-氨基苯甲酸甲磺酸（MS222）进行麻醉，并尽力减少痛苦。
text_en: Before euthanasia and processing, experimental Carassius auratus gibelio were anesthetized with ethyl-3-aminobenzoate methanesulfonate (MS222), and every effort was made to minimize suffering.

quote: All fish of YG group were fed with a basal diet containing 800 mg/kg (we referred to the addition in piglet, performed by Qin et al., 2019) YG (YG group), antibiotic group were fed with a basal diet containing 200 mg/kg Rifampicin serving as a positive control (PC group).
statement: YG组鱼饲喂含800 mg/kg YG的基础日粮，抗生素组（PC组）饲喂含200 mg/kg利福平的基础日粮作为阳性对照。
text_zh: YG组鱼饲喂含800 mg/kg YG的基础日粮，抗生素组（PC组）饲喂含200 mg/kg利福平的基础日粮作为阳性对照。
text_en: The YG group fish were fed a basal diet containing 800 mg/kg YG, and the antibiotic group (PC group) was fed a basal diet containing 200 mg/kg rifampicin as a positive control.

quote: After 2 weeks, each fish in YG group, PC group and NC group was injected intramuscularly with 2 × LD50 viable A. caviae.
statement: 两周后，YG组、PC组和NC组的每条鱼均肌肉注射2×LD50的活体A. caviae。
text_zh: 两周后，YG组、PC组和NC组的每条鱼均肌肉注射2×LD50的活体A. caviae。
text_en: Two weeks later, fish in the YG group, PC group, and NC group were each intramuscularly injected with 2×LD50 of live A. caviae.

quote: Signs of disease C. gibelio were characterized as hepatosplenomegaly and abdominal hyperaemia.
statement: 患病鲫鱼的疾病特征表现为肝脾肿大和腹部充血。
text_zh: 患病鲫鱼的疾病特征表现为肝脾肿大和腹部充血。
text_en: The disease characteristics of diseased crucian carp are hepatosplenomegaly and abdominal congestion.

quote: The results showed that 1 × 10 8 CFU/ml was the minimum lethal concentration.
statement: 结果显示，1 × 10^8 CFU/ml是最低致死浓度。
text_zh: 结果显示，1 × 10^8 CFU/ml是最低致死浓度。
text_en: The results showed that 1 × 10^8 CFU/ml was the minimum lethal concentration.

quote: When the concentration reached 1 × 10 7 CFU/ml, the cumulative mortality was more than 50%.
statement: 当浓度达到1 × 10^7 CFU/ml时，累积死亡率超过50%。
text_zh: 当浓度达到1 × 10^7 CFU/ml时，累积死亡率超过50%。
text_en: When the concentration reached 1 × 10^7 CFU/ml, the cumulative mortality exceeded 50%.

quote: To minimize handling stress and injury, fish were acclimated for over 2 h and transferred using a submerged net method by trained personnel, with out-of-water time kept under 1 min, resulting in no observed physical damage throughout the study.
statement: 通过驯化超过2小时、使用浸没网法转移以及将离水时间控制在1分钟以内，可以最小化处理应激和损伤，且未观察到物理损伤。
text_zh: 通过驯化超过2小时、使用浸没网法转移以及将离水时间控制在1分钟以内，可以最小化处理应激和损伤，且未观察到物理损伤。
text_en: Stress and damage can be minimized by acclimation for more than 2 hours, transfer using the submerged net method, and keeping air exposure time within 1 minute, with no physical damage observed.

population.species: P. pingi, crucian carp, yellow catfish

quote: The cleaning procedure involved scrubbing the tanks with a diluted bleach solution (1% sodium hypochlorite) followed by copious rinsing with tap water.
statement: 清洁程序包括用稀释的漂白剂溶液（1%次氯酸钠）擦洗水箱，随后用大量自来水冲洗。
text_zh: 清洁程序包括用稀释的漂白剂溶液（1%次氯酸钠）擦洗水箱，随后用大量自来水冲洗。
text_en: The cleaning procedure includes scrubbing the water tanks with a diluted bleach solution (1% sodium hypochlorite), followed by rinsing with large amounts of tap water.

quote: To ensure the complete removal of any residual disinfectant that could harm the fish, the tanks were then treated with a sodium thiosulfate solution for neutralization and finally rinsed three times with dechlorinated water.
statement: 为确保完全去除可能伤害鱼类的残留消毒剂，水箱随后用硫代硫酸钠溶液中和，最后用脱氯水冲洗三次。
text_zh: 为确保完全去除可能伤害鱼类的残留消毒剂，水箱随后用硫代硫酸钠溶液中和，最后用脱氯水冲洗三次。
text_en: To ensure the complete removal of residual disinfectants that may harm fish, the water tanks were subsequently neutralized with a sodium thiosulfate solution and finally rinsed three times with dechlorinated water.
intervention_record: 硫代硫酸钠中和消毒剂

quote: In Palaemon sinensis infected with Tachaea chinensis , the host enhances glycolysis and the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle to release more energy in response to the infection pressure [ 16 ].
statement: 感染中华鳃尾虫的中华小长臂虾通过增强糖酵解和三羧酸循环来释放更多能量以应对感染压力。
text_zh: 感染中华鳃尾虫的中华小长臂虾通过增强糖酵解和三羧酸循环来释放更多能量以应对感染压力。
text_en: Macrobrachium nipponense infected with Sinergasilus maritimus releases more energy to cope with infection stress by enhancing glycolysis and the tricarboxylic acid cycle.

quote: In a zebrafish model, the study found that salicylaldehyde, produced by the gut microbe Pelomonas, is a potent anti-parasitic agent capable of inhibiting egg hatching in Pseudocapillaria tomentosa , both in vitro and in vivo [ 17 ].
statement: 在斑马鱼模型中，研究发现由肠道微生物Pelomonas产生的水杨醛是一种强效抗寄生虫剂，能在体外和体内抑制Pseudocapillaria tomentosa的卵孵化。
text_zh: 在斑马鱼模型中，研究发现由肠道微生物Pelomonas产生的水杨醛是一种强效抗寄生虫剂，能在体外和体内抑制Pseudocapillaria tomentosa的卵孵化。
text_en: In zebrafish models, research found that salicylaldehyde produced by the gut microbe Pelomonas is a potent anti-parasitic agent that inhibits egg hatching of Pseudocapillaria tomentosa in vitro and in vivo.

quote: In grass carp infected with Dactylogyrus lamellatus in the gills, even though the infection site is localized to the gills, the composition of their gut microbiota undergoes significant alterations [ 18 ].
statement: 在鳃部感染Dactylogyrus lamellatus的草鱼中，尽管感染部位局限于鳃，但其肠道微生物群的组成发生了显著变化。
text_zh: 在鳃部感染Dactylogyrus lamellatus的草鱼中，尽管感染部位局限于鳃，但其肠道微生物群的组成发生了显著变化。
text_en: In grass carp with gill infections of Dactylogyrus lamellatus, although the infection site was limited to the gills, significant changes occurred in the composition of their gut microbiota.

quote: Acinetobacter was identified as the best biomarker for Sparus aurata parasitized by Enteromyxum leei [ 19 ].
statement: 不动杆菌属被确定为感染Enteromyxum leei的金头鲷的最佳生物标志物。
text_zh: 不动杆菌属被确定为感染Enteromyxum leei的金头鲷的最佳生物标志物。
text_en: Acinetobacter was identified as the best biomarker for Enteromyxum leei infection in gilthead seabream.

quote: As A. caviae infecting C. gibelio has multiple antibiotic resistance, development of a microecological preparation is an alternative and promising prophylactic method to provide protection against A. caviae .
statement: 由于感染鲤鲫的A. caviae具有多重耐药性，开发生态制剂被视为一种替代且有前景的保护方法。
text_zh: 由于感染鲤鲫的A. caviae具有多重耐药性，开发生态制剂被视为一种替代且有前景的保护方法。
text_en: Because A. caviae infecting carp and crucian carp has multidrug resistance, the development of probiotics is regarded as an alternative and promising protective method.

quote: Community barplot analysis demonstrated that YG supplement could more significantly increase the microbial diversity in the gut and decrease the relative abundance of Aeromonas than antibiotic did in vivo.
statement: 群落条形图分析表明，在体内实验中，与抗生素相比，YG补充剂能更显著地增加肠道微生物多样性并降低气单胞菌属的相对丰度。
text_zh: 群落条形图分析表明，在体内实验中，与抗生素相比，YG补充剂能更显著地增加肠道微生物多样性并降低气单胞菌属的相对丰度。
text_en: Bar chart analysis of the community indicated that, in in vivo experiments, compared with antibiotics, YG supplements more significantly increased intestinal microbial diversity and reduced the relative abundance of Aeromonas.

quote: Therefore , YG supplement could efficiently inhibit A. caviae both in vivo and in vitro, and contribute to intestine health.
statement: 因此，YG补充剂能在体内和体外有效抑制A. caviae，并有助于肠道健康。
text_zh: 因此，YG补充剂能在体内和体外有效抑制A. caviae，并有助于肠道健康。
text_en: Therefore, YG supplement can effectively inhibit A. caviae in vivo and in vitro, and contributes to gut health.

quote: In this study, we observed that hepatic AK and PK activities in C. gibelio were inhibited by A. caviae , which resulted in decreased availability of hepatic ATP.
statement: 本研究观察到维氏气单胞菌抑制了异育银鲫肝脏中的腺苷酸激酶（AK）和丙酮酸激酶（PK）活性，导致肝脏ATP可用性降低。
text_zh: 本研究观察到维氏气单胞菌抑制了异育银鲫肝脏中的腺苷酸激酶（AK）和丙酮酸激酶（PK）活性，导致肝脏ATP可用性降低。
text_en: This study observed that Aeromonas veronii inhibited adenylate kinase (AK) and pyruvate kinase (PK) activity in the liver of gibel carp, leading to reduced ATP availability in the liver.

quote: This leads to the appearance of visible white spots on the fish’s body, a condition known as ichthyophthiriasis or white spot disease.
statement: 这导致鱼体表出现可见的白色斑点，即小瓜虫病或白点病。
text_zh: 这导致鱼体表出现可见的白色斑点，即小瓜虫病或白点病。
text_en: This leads to visible white spots on the fish body surface, namely Ichthyophthiriasis or white spot disease.

quote: Due to its simple life cycle, low host specificity, and wide distribution, I. multifiliis causes high mortality in infected fish.
statement: 由于其简单的生活史、低宿主特异性和广泛分布，多子小瓜虫导致受感染鱼类的高死亡率。
text_zh: 由于其简单的生活史、低宿主特异性和广泛分布，多子小瓜虫导致受感染鱼类的高死亡率。
text_en: Due to its simple life cycle, low host specificity and wide distribution, Ichthyophthirius multifiliis causes high mortality in infected fish.

quote: Clayton and Price found that two goodeid species derived from wild populations, Ameca splendens and Ilyodon xantusi , were more susceptible to I. multifiliis than two poeciliid species with longer domestication histories, Xiphophorus maculatus and Xiphophorus variatus [ 5 ].

text_zh: Clayton和Price发现，源自野生种群的两种Goodeidae科鱼类（Ameca splendens和Ilyodon xantusi）比驯化历史较长的两种Poeciliidae科鱼类（Xiphophorus maculatus和Xiphophorus variatus）更容易感染多子小瓜虫。
text_en: Clayton and Price found that two Goodeidae fish species from wild populations (Ameca splendens and Ilyodon xantusi) were more susceptible to Ichthyophthirius multifiliis than two Poeciliidae fish species with a longer history of domestication (Xiphophorus maculatus and Xiphophorus variatus).

text_en: In negative ion mode, compared with crucian carp, upregulated metabolites in P. pingi were associated with oxidative stress levels (oxidized glutathione and uric acid) and immune/allergic responses (histamine and N-acetylhistamine).

text_en: During this period, feeding, swimming, and body surface health were observed and recorded daily to ensure there were no clinical signs of Ichthyophthirius multifiliis infection or other diseases.

statement: 三种鱼均饲喂相同的商业沉性颗粒饲料，其营养成分符合特定标准，且1.5毫米直径的颗粒适合7克重的鱼摄入。

text_en: All three fish species were fed the same commercial sinking pellet feed, whose nutritional composition met specific standards, and the 1.5 mm diameter pellets were suitable for ingestion by fish weighing 7 g.

quote: The maintenance of a high antioxidant “baseline” may represent a proactive energy investment that pre-empts the high cost of an inflammatory immune response, which is characteristic of the susceptible species in our study.
statement: 维持高抗氧化基线可能代表一种主动的能量投入，从而预先阻止炎症免疫反应的高昂成本。

text_en: Maintaining a high antioxidant baseline may represent an active energy investment, thereby preempting the high cost of inflammatory immune responses.
outcome: 氧化应激与免疫反应成本

quote: During over a decade of resource conservation and artificial domestication practices, our research team observed that Percocypris pingi is highly resistant to I. multifiliis infection.
statement: 经过十多年的资源保护和人工驯化实践，研究团队观察到 Percocypris pingi 对多子小瓜虫感染具有高度抗性。
text_zh: 经过十多年的资源保护和人工驯化实践，研究团队观察到 Percocypris pingi 对多子小瓜虫感染具有高度抗性。
text_en: After more than ten years of resource conservation and artificial domestication practices, the research team observed that Percocypris pingi has high resistance to Ichthyophthirius multifiliis infection.

quote: No infections were detected from the larval, juvenile, sub-adult, or adult stages, even during severe outbreaks or when cohabiting with infected fish
statement: 即使在严重爆发或与受感染鱼类混养期间，幼体、稚鱼、亚成体或成体阶段均未检测到感染。
text_zh: 即使在严重爆发或与受感染鱼类混养期间，幼体、稚鱼、亚成体或成体阶段均未检测到感染。
text_en: No infection was detected in the larval, juvenile, sub-adult or adult stages, even during severe outbreaks or co-culture with infected fish.

quote: The susceptibility and resistance of P. pingi to four other freshwater fish species—southern catfish (Silurus meridionalis), grass carp, Schizothorax prenanti , and topmouth culter (Culter alburnus)—demonstrated that P. pingi restricts the parasitism and growth of I. multifiliis trophonts
statement: P. pingi 与其他四种淡水鱼类的易感性和抗性比较表明，P. pingi 限制了多子小瓜虫滋养体的寄生和生长。
text_zh: P. pingi 与其他四种淡水鱼类的易感性和抗性比较表明，P. pingi 限制了多子小瓜虫滋养体的寄生和生长。
text_en: Comparisons of susceptibility and resistance between P. pingi and four other freshwater fish species indicate that P. pingi restricts the parasitism and growth of Ichthyophthirius multifiliis trophonts.

quote: These fish not only regulate and clear excess reactive oxygen species (ROS) effectively to mitigate tissue damage but also employ specific anti-parasitic proteins, such as L-amino acid oxidase (LAAO), for direct action against C. irritans
statement: 这些鱼类不仅有效调节和清除过量的活性氧以减轻组织损伤，还利用特定的抗寄生虫蛋白（如L-氨基酸氧化酶）直接作用于刺激隐核虫。
text_zh: 这些鱼类不仅有效调节和清除过量的活性氧以减轻组织损伤，还利用特定的抗寄生虫蛋白（如L-氨基酸氧化酶）直接作用于刺激隐核虫。
text_en: These fish not only effectively regulate and remove excess reactive oxygen species to reduce tissue damage, but also use specific anti-parasitic proteins (such as L-amino acid oxidase) to directly act on Cryptocaryon irritans.
intervention_record: 清除活性氧及抗寄生虫蛋白

quote: Conversely, in susceptible species like the large yellow croaker (Larimichthys crocea), infection by C. irritans induces systemic oxidative stress, characterized by a significant decrease in hepatic glutathione peroxidase (GSH-Px) activity, a sharp increase in superoxide dismutase (SOD), and a peak in the oxidative damage marker malondialdehyde (MDA) within hours
statement: 相反，在大黄鱼等易感物种中，刺激隐核虫感染会诱导全身性氧化应激，其特征是肝脏谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性显著下降、超氧化物歧化酶急剧增加以及氧化损伤标志物丙二醛在数小时内达到峰值。
text_zh: 相反，在大黄鱼等易感物种中，刺激隐核虫感染会诱导全身性氧化应激，其特征是肝脏谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶活性显著下降、超氧化物歧化酶急剧增加以及氧化损伤标志物丙二醛在数小时内达到峰值。
text_en: Conversely, in susceptible species such as large yellow croaker, Cryptocaryon irritans infection induces systemic oxidative stress, characterized by a significant decrease in hepatic glutathione peroxidase activity, a sharp increase in superoxide dismutase, and malondialdehyde, a marker of oxidative damage, peaking within hours.

quote: Similarly, infection of Coris julis by Scaphanocephalus sp. triggers the activation of antioxidant enzymes (SOD, CAT, glutathione S-transferase) in mucosal tissues, underscoring their role as a first line of defense
statement: 同样，Scaphanocephalus sp. 感染 Coris julis 会触发黏膜组织中抗氧化酶的激活，强调了它们作为第一道防线的作用。
text_zh: 同样，Scaphanocephalus sp. 感染 Coris julis 会触发黏膜组织中抗氧化酶的激活，强调了它们作为第一道防线的作用。
text_en: Similarly, Scaphanocephalus sp. infection in Coris julis triggers the activation of antioxidant enzymes in mucosal tissue, highlighting their role as the first line of defense.

quote: I. multifiliis invasion induces intense oxidative stress in the host, and such infection causes tissue damage via lipid peroxidation in susceptible species like silver catfish
statement: 多子小瓜虫入侵会在宿主中诱导强烈的氧化应激，并且在银鲶等易感物种中，这种感染通过脂质过氧化造成组织损伤。
text_zh: 多子小瓜虫入侵会在宿主中诱导强烈的氧化应激，并且在银鲶等易感物种中，这种感染通过脂质过氧化造成组织损伤。
text_en: Ichthyophthirius multifiliis invasion induces strong oxidative stress in hosts, and in susceptible species such as silver catfish, this infection causes tissue damage through lipid peroxidation.

quote: This deficiency suggests a severely limited capacity to mount an immediate, pre-emptive defense against the parasite-induced oxidative burst, leaving skin tissues vulnerable to damage.
statement: 这种缺陷表明其针对寄生虫诱导的氧化爆发建立立即、先发制人防御的能力严重受限，使皮肤组织容易受到损伤。
text_zh: 这种缺陷表明其针对寄生虫诱导的氧化爆发建立立即、先发制人防御的能力严重受限，使皮肤组织容易受到损伤。
text_en: This defect indicates that its ability to establish an immediate, preemptive defense against parasite-induced oxidative bursts is severely limited, making skin tissue susceptible to damage.

quote: Instead, the upregulation of metabolites related to immune and inflammatory responses, such as histamine, in these susceptible species indicates a shift towards a costly and potentially detrimental reactive sta
statement: 相反，这些易感物种中与免疫和炎症反应相关的代谢物（如组胺）的上调，表明向一种昂贵且潜在有害的反应状态转变。
text_zh: 相反，这些易感物种中与免疫和炎症反应相关的代谢物（如组胺）的上调，表明向一种昂贵且潜在有害的反应状态转变。
text_en: Conversely, the upregulation of metabolites associated with immune and inflammatory responses (such as histamine) in these susceptible species indicates a shift towards an energetically costly and potentially harmful response state.

statement: 本研究开发了一种多重PCR检测方法，用于同时检测这四种粘孢子虫。

text_en: This study developed a multiplex PCR detection method for the simultaneous detection of these four myxosporeans.

text_en: The detection limits of this multiplex PCR assay for Thelohanellus wuhanensis, Myxobolus honghuensis, Myxobolus ulii, and Myxobolus rotundicauda were 0.2, 0.3, 3.1, and 3.8 spores, respectively.

quote: The most indicative finding was the significant depletion of the parasitic bacteria C. Megaira and C. Midichloria on P. pingi skin.
